meaning: Tests the message rival STMT-JESUS-MANDATE-COVERS-ONLY-MESSAGE against the multiple-attestation argument for a governing commission. Premises: the link premise STMT-CHURCH-FOUNDED-IN-COMMISSIONED-APOSTLES (Lumen gentium §§19, 22); STMT-JOHN-COMMISSION-INDEPENDENT-OF-MATTHEW (John 20.21-23's commission saying is independent of Matthew 18.17-18's or of Matthew 16.18-19's); and STMT-HEAVEN-RATIFIED-ATTESTATION-CRITERION (if two distinct, independent reports each name a heaven-ratified power, Jesus gave or promised some heaven-ratified power). Conclusion STMT-MESSAGE-RIVAL-EXCLUDED-GIVEN-FOUNDING: wherever Jesus holds a mandate from g, founded the Catholic Church and it is visible with authority, the rival is false. The step goes through the reported content: the heaven-ratified family (binding and loosing, forgiving and retaining) is reported in both the Matthean and the Johannine strand (CommissionAttestation.heavenRatified_in_both_strands) and every power in it is governing. Each premise is needed: in each of the three models of CommissionAttestation.omissionModels the other two premises hold, Jesus holds a mandate from some g, founded the Catholic Church and it is visible with authority, the rival holds and the conclusion fails (all stated in the type through RivalWithFounding); all three premises are jointly satisfiable with Jesus' mandate, stage 6 and every stage antecedent of the founding bridge (CommissionAttestation.jointModel). Read off the result: a rival granting the link premise, Jesus' mandate and his founding of the Catholic Church as a visible society with authority, must deny John's independence (from both Matthew 18.17-18 and 16.18-19) or the criterion for this family; otherwise it denies the link premise, the mandate or the founding (stage 5, Harnack's own route in §2). A rival denying only the powers of Matthew 16.19 (keys, binding and loosing), with the two attestation premises, is committed to forgiving and retaining having been given (CommissionAttestation.matt16PowersNotGiven_forces_john); one denying the whole family rejects independence or the criterion (familyNotGiven_rejects_attestation). No pinned source states either denial: Harnack's note 76 dates the words of Matthew 16.18 and 18.17 (STMT-MATT-16-18-18-17-SAYINGS-LATER) and Renan states a possibility about many words on binding and remitting (STMT-COMMUNITY-ATTRIBUTION-OF-CHURCH-POWERS-POSSIBLE). The independence and criterion premises are unsourced; the conclusion is used by no argument reaching the root.
